seo_title: North Charleston Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 6 Events
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in North Charleston for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from Holy City Christmas at Holy City Brewing (opening November 27) through the Nutcracker Magical Christmas Ballet (December 26), with Cirque Dreams Holidaze (December 1), the Park Circle Christmas Tree Lighting and Cookies and Cocoa with Santa (December 4) and the Christmas Parade and Festival (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in North Charleston

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in North Charleston
  • 3 free events, including the Christmas Tree Lighting, Cookies and Cocoa with Santa (registration required) and the Christmas Parade and Festival
  • Meet Santa: Cookies and Cocoa with Santa (December 4) and Holy City Christmas at Holy City Brewing (November 27 to December 20)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Christmas Tree Lighting (December 4) and the Christmas Parade and Festival (December 5)
  • Shows: Cirque Dreams Holidaze (December 1) and the Nutcracker Magical Christmas Ballet (December 26) at the North Charleston Performing Arts Center
  • Season: November 27 to December 26

Planning a bigger day out? North Charleston families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Charleston, which covers the Holiday Festival of Lights, A Christmas Carol and the Christmas Parade and Festival.
